title: OA TABLE 69 - the martial style combinations: the three forms and eight principal methods with their AC, attack and damage mods and the coded body parts
audit_comment: OA round seventy-eight (capture p. 226): Table 69 - the martial style combinations grid, the three forms and eight methods across four columns with the derived-style examples, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA TABLE 69, printed capture p. 226 - the martial style combinations round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE FORM ROWS: Hard the AC 1, attack 1, damage 4 - the muscles and bones for power; Soft the AC 3, attack 0 - the only zero of the grid, damage 2 - the inner power; Hard/Soft the 2/1/3 of the best practices from each. THE METHOD ROWS: Kick the 1/1/4 of the Foot; Lock the 1/1/2 of the Body; Movement the 2/1/2 of the Legs; Push the 2/1/1 of the Hand; Strike the 1/1/1 of the Hand; Throw the 1/1/2 of the whole Body; Vital Area the 2/1/1 of the Hand and Foot; Weapon the 1/1 of the Hand and Arm, the damage BY WEAPON - pinned 0, not a mod, the R662 convention. THE USE: the mods totaled per the R690 mechanics - the AC from the 10, the attacks style-specific, the damage rounded up to the die, the body part free; the derived examples prove it within the round - Hard plus Kick the AC 8, attacks 2, damage 8; Soft plus Movement the damage 4. The grid codifies per the R431 calculus

col_comments: the Table 69 armor class mods by row ordinal (print capture p. 226): rows 0-2 the forms - Hard 1, Soft 3, Hard/Soft 2; rows 3-10 the methods - Kick 1, Lock 1, Movement 2, Push 2, Strike 1, Throw 1, Vital Area 2, Weapon 1; the AC of a style 10 minus the totaled form and method mods

the Table 69 attack mods by row ordinal (print capture p. 226): the forms - Hard 1, Soft 0 - the only zero of the grid, Hard/Soft 1; every method a 1; the number of attacks the totaled form and method mods

the Table 69 damage mods by row ordinal (print capture p. 226): the forms - Hard 4, Soft 2, Hard/Soft 3; the methods - Kick 4, Lock 2, Movement 2, Push 1, Strike 1, Throw 2, Vital Area 1; the Weapon row a 0 - the printed damage BY WEAPON, not a mod, the R662 convention; the damage the totaled mods rounded up to the nearest die - 6 the 1d6, 4 the 1d4, 5 the 1d6

the Table 69 body parts by row ordinal, coded (print capture p. 226): 0 none - the form rows printed a dash; 1 Foot (Kick), 2 Body (Lock and Throw), 3 Legs (Movement), 4 Hand (Push and Strike), 5 Hand and Foot (Vital Area), 6 Hand and Arm (Weapon); kicking the feet, throwing the whole body, the attacks effective so long as the part is unbound or free to move
